introduction.text: Forte Appia Antica is one of Rome's 15 forts built in the late 19th century, located in the Ardeatino quarter. It played a role in military history and remains a protected cultural site.

history.description: Construction of Forte Appia Antica began in 1877 and was completed in 1880, forming part of Rome's network of forts.
The fort served as the headquarters of the Artillery Directorate of the Aeronautical Corps until the 1910s.
Between the 1980s and 1990s, the fort was used by the Aeronautical Military's Automated Information Systems Division as a data processing center.
The fort was officially protected as a cultural heritage site by the decree dated 6 August 2008.
